title: Clip match
description: One measured animation clip from the Meshy pipeline (F6), recorded by Clip Matcher (data/clips/<id>.json). Frame data must match it (F2). Frames are 60-tick game frames, 1-based.

source.description: Meshy animation-library preset or a prompt-generated take (F6).

clip.description: Library preset name, or the generated take's id/file under the clip spec in assets/specs/clips/.

trim_start.description: Raw tick (60 per second, in the take's GLB) shown on game frame 1. Set with trim_end. Read by ClipCatalog before the notes.

trim_end.description: Last raw tick of the trim (inclusive); playback clamps here. Set with trim_start.

speed_scale.description: Raw ticks per game frame: game frame n shows raw tick trim_start + (n-1) * speed_scale. Default 1.

file.description: The take's GLB, relative to game/ (normally assets/generated/clips/<fighter>/<file>.glb).

yaw_offset.description: Degrees the take is turned about the vertical axis relative to the fighter's facing (presentation only). Default 0.

hit_start.description: First frame the clip visibly hits or releases a projectile; null for clips that never hit (e.g. a teleport).

retarget_notes.description: Retarget result per yokai (G4), e.g. tail/shell/club clipping.
